given.note: Lee Associates has the sensitive switch on. In this example Alex writes to Rosie in Arabic and gave the name in Arabic script, an alphabet with no capital letters (Unicode Lo); Rosie answers in the language of the text (arch 06 line 341). Alex's weekly session with Maya on Sat Nov 7 at 11:00am goes on Maya's Outlook calendar as 'Visit' and the initials of the name as written, one letter and a dot per name part, and nothing else (RULES 4.6; S13-22; K-03 v1's initials form; arch 05 line 267). The Arabic spelling of Alex M. is a transliteration made for this fixture; the session's date and length are an illustration (the shop's sessions are weekly).
